articles.summary: Veteran public-company executive brings extensive experience in financial leadership, capital markets and strategic growth GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), a technology-driven commerce and platform company serving the firearms, ammunition and outdoor industry, today announced the appointment of W. Bryan Hill to its Board of Directors, effective November 9, 2026. Mr. Hill’s appointment further strengthens the Board’s public-company, financial and strategic expertise. Mr. Hill will serve on the Audit and MA Committees. The Board has determined that he is independent under New York Stock Exchange listing standards. “Bryan’s public-company leadership, financial discipline and strategic experience further strengthen our Board,” said Marc Nemati, President and Chief Executive Officer of GrabAGun. “His background in scaling technology businesses, capital allocation and financial oversight will be valuable as we advance our commerce and platform
articles.title: GrabAGun Appoints W. Bryan Hill to Board of Directors
